name: io.github.Fabsbags/starreview
title: StarPresence
description: Drafts Google & TripAdvisor review replies; agents can never post themselves. Free get_service_info.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Required at this endpoint. Connect via OAuth (recommended, plug-and-play; discovered from the endpoint's .well-known/oauth-protected-resource) OR send an sragt_ bearer key as Authorization: Bearer sragt_.... Owner-created self-service keys are account-wide and use the multi-business picker; legacy/admin per-business credentials may pin one business. The free discovery tool (get_service_info) needs no credential but lives at a separate URL: POST https://mcp.starpresence.ai/public
